title: Climbing Stairs
statement: You can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Return how many distinct ways exist to reach the top of a staircase with n steps.

editor_note.idea: Each state depends on the previous one-step and two-step states, so the recurrence matches Fibonacci-style growth.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: Only the last two states are needed, so rolling variables are enough.
editor_note.edge_cases: Small n values are returned directly.
editor_note.pitfalls: Starting the recurrence with the wrong base cases shifts every later result.
